quotes.author: jackpal
quotes.text: Improved spec: Implement @filepath include processing for GEMINI.md files.   Ignore @ characters that appear in markdown code spans and markdown code blocks.   Spaces in paths should be escaped with a backslash (e.g., @My\ Documents/file.txt).   Use a real markdown parser such as marked to parse the files looking for @, so that code spans and code blocks can be reliably ignored.   parse all included files as markdown, no matter what their file extension is.   Allow a total of 5 levels of files, counting the original GEMINI.md as the first level. Ignore files deeper than 5 levels.   ignore miss

quotes.author: jackpal
quotes.text: It looks like pull request #2230 partially implemented this feature. The implementation is incompatible with the CLAUDE.md equivalent in (at least) the following ways:  It accepts @ imports everywhere in the text of the file, whereas CLAUDE.md ignores @ imports inside inline code quotes and code blocks. It only imports md files, whereas CLAUDE.md imports any file (and treats whatever it imports as a markdown file.) It defaults to an import depth of 10 vs claude's import depth limit of 5.  I think all three of these differences should be fixed, for compatibility sake.

It would be nice if there was a way to run some one-off command which output is not added to context, if there was as way to force approval of anything over say 10k, option to chose abandon (or some version of local summarise) before sending...

quotes.author: lesisty7
quotes.text: The consumption of tokens sent is something that definitely worries me. The relatively simple task of splitting 2 documents into separate files used 2.8 million tokens sent and only 23 thousand tokens received. For comparison, the entire process of creating a complete documentation of this project and these 2 files with test codes used 190 thousand tokens in AI Studio.
